gaps.lead: Given that he has no experience, will Glyn be able to do this job?
gaps.sentence: Will Glyn's ___ his ability to do this job?
gaps.hint: no experience = lack of experience (noun subject)
gaps.explanation: The noun subject 'lack of experience' takes the verb 'affect'.

gaps.lead: The guidebook says this bridge is Roman.

gaps.lead: If the government had acted sooner, the crisis could have been avoided.
gaps.sentence: ___ acted sooner, the crisis could have been avoided.
gaps.explanation: Dropping 'if' inverts auxiliary and subject: Had the government acted sooner…

gaps.lead: Brian was really interested in North American history in his school days.
gaps.sentence: Brian ___ North American history in his school days.

gaps.lead: The film we saw last week was better than this one.
